description:
Review of wave 1 (standards #1-3, spec v5d): Elixir mode does not apply defk-gtv's range limit (Ops.range/3 is a..b//step; 0..i64_max//2^62 raises ArithmeticError natively, returns 2 in Elixir mode), and the alloc cap differs (native DEFK_ALLOC_MAX_BYTES 2^60, Ops 2^48; between them the reasons differ). A test in elixir_mode_test.exs still labels alloc overflow a divergence pending defk-gtv, and rolling_stats is still compared with a 1e-5 tolerance though defk-jlk landed.

Fix: one cap, 2^48 bytes on 64-bit, in both modes (Elixir mode also raises native's 'out of memory' from 2^47 bytes, where asking the VM aborts it); the range check in Ops.range mirroring defk_range_limit; agreement tests for both limits; the stale test becomes agree/3; rolling_stats compared bit-exactly.

Done when range_limit_test and alloc_test cases also run in Elixir mode and agree, and mix test passes.
title: Reconcile Elixir-mode limits with native: alloc cap and range limit
